author: Animalogic
description:
What if one of the most powerful weapons in the animal kingdom wasn’t a claw… but a shockwave?

Meet the pistol shrimp, a tiny crustacean with a punch so powerful, it can stun prey, break glass-like shells, and even create temperatures as hot as the surface of the sun (for a split second). Using a specialized snapping claw, this ocean creature generates a cavitation bubble that collapses with explosive force, producing light, heat, and sound all at once.

Examining the nature of the beast.

From apex predators to the planet's strangest creatures, Animalogic goes deep into the science, behavior, and biology of the animal kingdom, one species at a time.
